pairs.why: A's posts and planks have smooth, quiet grain and a simple matte rope, like the real pier. B adds busy caustic ripples and more visible wood grain and rope texture.
Both balls have similar soft vinyl gloss and rippled sand, so surface finish gives no reason to choose.
A has the smooth painted-metal look with soft gloss highlights and reflective lenses, like the real viewer. B's flat grey face reads more matte and plain.
A's body is a satin, mostly matte plastic like the real calculator's. B has slightly more glossy edge highlights.
B has soft satin highlights on the canopy panels and a shiny pole, close to the real umbrella's smooth sheen. A reads flatter.
B's white shell is soft satin with gentle highlights, like the real unit. A is glossier, with a hard lacquer sheen and bright glow strips.
A's rope is smooth and soft with broad, quiet twist ridges, like the real scarf and fan. B's thin rope has fine, busy twist lines that are too texture-heavy.
Both ropes have similar fine twist texture and soft sheen, so surface finish gives no reason to choose.
